items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: CT — Clark Terry — played by ear. He worked all of his stuff out.

ctx.x: Stan Getz played by ear. Chet Baker played by ear. Okay? Chet Baker played by ear. I want to say Nat Adderley played by ear. CT — Clark Terry — played by ear. He worked all of his stuff out. Maynard Ferguson, now people might go naa, but Maynard Ferg — baloney. Listen to the early recordings of Maynard ‘cause Maynard could play some bebop. Okay? Maynard, he had F’s above double high C louder than anybody in the business but, and he told this to Art Falbush who teaches at Oneonta, SUNY Oneonta, because Art’s…

play by ear. And he interviewed a bunch of people. And Maynard was one of them. And so Maynard told Art, he said the biggest mistake I did was that Dizzy asked me to come to his house so we could work on some harmony, work on some piano stuff. He goes that was the biggest mistake I did that I didn’t follow Dizzy’s advice. But he goes, but what I did learn was that if I wasn’t going to do that the ear had to be king. In other words your ears have got to be right. You’ve got to be able to know when you’re not doing…
